title: Double counting of referral scores leading to over-claiming of tokens
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  An attacker can exploit the referral scoring system in `BunniToken.sol` by minting tokens using one referrer (`referrer1`), and then minting additional tokens using a different referrer (`referrer2`). This manipulation results in the score for the first referrer being transferred to the second referrer, leading to double counting of the score.
